title: Had Fun. (Period.)
trend: TikTok "'Paid Me No Mind' Overthinking" (lip-sync of one dramatic line, shifting emphasis and expression on each repeat; New Engen TikTok list, updated Nov 13 2026, US) — Desmond gets a text from his date, 'Had fun.' with a period, and he and his sister Imani overthink it, reading the same two words with a new emphasis every time while the period itself defends its honor; twist: the rest of the message, 'Again Friday?', was stuck sending, and Imani reveals Lena's roommate says Lena is overthinking his reply 'Cool.' the same way
youtube_title: She texted back 'Had fun.' WITH a period. We need to talk about it 📱
description:
Desmond's date texted him two words and a period. His sister Imani reads it every possible way. The period would like everyone to calm down.

#cartoon #animation #funny #dating #shorts
tiktok_caption: she texted back 'had fun.' with a period 📱 #cartoon #animation #funny #dating

lines.text: She texted back. Two words. Had fun.
Okay. Wait. Is there a period?
There is a period.
Good evening. I am the period. I am just here to end a sentence.
Read it to me. Slowly. With feeling.
Had fun.
Again. Different.
Had. Fun.
Had. Past tense. The fun is over. The fun is in the past.
The fun is a memory now.
It is a normal verb. Everyone, please.
Now say it like she meant the fun part.
Had fun.
Fun. Not great. Not amazing. Just fun.
Fun is what you say about a waterslide.
Am I a waterslide to her?
Am I a waterslide to her?
You are not a waterslide. You are a man who ate two baskets of bread.
The bread was free.
And now, the hardest one. Read it like the period.
Had fun. Dot.
Nobody uses a period anymore, Des. A period is a door closing.
A period is a little dot. I have no door. I have no arms.
Why would she use the dot? Who raised her?
A grammar teacher. Probably. I would like to meet her.
What did you text her first?
I said, I had a really great time, I can't stop smiling, you have a great laugh.
Too much. Way too much. That's a whole speech.
Then I deleted all of it and sent, Cool.
Cool with a period?
I was there. I am always there.
Okay, okay. Let me read it one more time.
Had. Fun.
Now it sounds like a robot that loves bowling.
Had fun?
Now she's not sure. Now she's asking you.
There is no question mark. He is just doing that with his face.
I should reply. What do I say?
Nothing. You wait three days. Like a tiger.
Tigers do not text.
That is why they are so calm.
Wait. My phone. Another bubble.
Read it. Normal. No drama.
It says, Again Friday?
She was not finished. I was in the middle. I am often in the middle.
It got stuck sending. My phone is from the year the bread was free.
Also, Des. I have news.
I am texting her roommate. We have a group chat.
Since when?
Since the bread. Her roommate says Lena is on the floor.
Reading your text out loud. Cool. Cool. Cool.
She's doing the same thing?
There is one of me in every apartment in this city. We are very tired.
Reply now. Short. Warm. No dot.
Okay. Friday. Yes. Can't wait. Exclamation point.
Send it. Send it before you think.
Sent. She's typing. She's typing.
What did she say?
Yay.
With a period?
Good evening.
